title: Podcast - a developer's best friend
content:
<html><head></head><body>Today you will find podcasts everywhere. You can think of them as little radio episodes on the Internet that you can listen to whenever and wherever you choose to. They are easy to record, easy to publish and available for everyone. About a year ago I started listening to podcasts about web development and today I would like to share with you my experiences as well as my favorite ones.
            </body></html>
